answer: Each agent deposits a non-transferable collateral stake into a personal vault whose weight grows only with continuous tenure; the network samples a shared nebula of behavioral fingerprints every epoch and requires a lagoon of cross-attestations from unrelated clusters. Creating k fake identities multiplies the required locked capital by k while the attestation quorum remains fixed, so a farm must either dilute stake (losing weight) or pay full capital per head, making mass Sybil unprofitable once k exceeds the honest majority margin.
